static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.social_status: 有几位可倾诉的朋友，但对Self-doubt与not安全感not易敞开
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往not yet因心理问题接受治疗；deny类似问题的既往史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性强，能觉察并描述负性自动思维；配合度高，态度积极；情绪以Anxiety与not确定为主

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直认为自己not够聪明，without法写出一本小说，这种信念阻碍了我成为记者的愿望。
basic_info.core_demands: When these negative thoughts began to affect my academic performance and overall health, I decided to seek counseling. I really want to find a way to get past these doubts.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/能力not足
I am not as good as others

special_situations.event: In the writing workshop, classmates share work that is considered more polished and insightful
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的作品have not同学那么好，就说明I am not smart enough，也not可能成为Writer/记者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In workshops, mainly observes and speaks little, reducing exposure and evaluation; tries to suppress doubts with positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远比not过他们，我就是not够聪明。

special_situations.event: 在完成写作作业时出现困难、卡壳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我写not顺或一时完成not好，就证明我天生not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延或回避继续投入，降低参与度以避免失败感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这再次证明我not行，我写not出有意义的东西。

special_situations.event: After starting a writing degree, exposed to more excellent writing and high-standard demands
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在还达not到很高的水准，将来也not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁与他人比较，提前在心里降低期待以防失望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 照这样发展下去，我终究not适合写作，也做not了记者。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 要么我能写出像小说那样高水平的作品，要么就说明I am not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在开始前过度自我评估、犹豫not前，减少尝试以避免“失败”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我写not出小说，就证明I am not smart enough。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable writer, gaining a sense of competence and worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较中显得not如人、被negate与羞辱，最终失败
defense_goal: 通过减少暴露与参与来避免被评价与受挫
以自我苛责与降低期待来预防失望
以追求“完美标准”来证明价值、对抗without能感

object_relations.self_representation: 能力not足、容易被看出缺点的Student/写作者
object_relations.object_representation: 更聪明且挑剔的评判者（同伴/读者/潜在导师）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in sessions reviewing others' workshop works being praised, being invited to share, or talking about self-evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人或咨询师会看到我的not足并negate我（将他人视为挑剔的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气自责、降低自我评价，use“I am not smart enough/我not行”之类表述，回避展开自我能力的具体证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被直接聚焦当前感受（如Shame, anxiety）并探索其来源时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 表达情绪会暴露弱点并带来负面评价
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Turning to talk about study plans or techniques, narrating in conceptualized, objectified language, reducing emotional vocabulary and details of subjective experience.

manifestations: 虽然有朋友可谈，但难以就Self-doubt与not安全感敞开
在比较与Self-denial中感到与同伴疏离
outcomes: 避免表达脆弱感受，进一步加重Self-doubt与Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial（“I am not smart enough”），在互动中过度担心被评价
工作坊中更倾向旁观，谨慎发言以避免暴露“not足”

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，将原本对外的能量Turning against the self。
manifestations: 遇到写作困难与比较情境时，将挫败与愤怒内化为自责与Withdrawal
减少求助与表达需求，转而自我苛责

positive_force: 具备学习动力（攻读写作学位）
有一定社会支持（有几位可谈心的朋友）
已尝试积极自我对话以对抗消极念头
主动寻求咨询与愿意行动检验信念
negative_force: 核心负性信念（“I am not smart enough”）导致普遍的Self-doubt
过度比较与黑白分明思维、预测not yet来等认知歪曲
在关键情境中的回避与Withdrawal（减少参与与表达）
难以向他人敞开脆弱感受，形成Interpersonal tension与支持利用not足
学业受挫与Decreased motivation，构成负向循环

target_behavior.behavior: 反复的Self-denial与负性思维反刍（“I am not smart enough/写not出有意义的作品”）
antecedent: 参加写作工作坊、看到同伴高质量作品
独自坐下来开始写作、遇到写作卡壳
与他人比较能力与成果
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在核心信念“I am not smart enough”被trigger，并以过度比较与灾难化推断进行自我验证
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与羞耻感，获得短暂的心理防护（降低期待、暂时减少尝试的Anxiety）
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance、Reduced motivation、Interpersonal tension与兴趣活动参与减少

target_behavior.behavior: 在写作与交流情境中的回避与Withdrawal（减少发言、避免分享作品与参与）
antecedent: 需要公开展示或讨论写作的课堂/工作坊场合
被邀请对作品进行自我评估或接受反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被negate与丢脸，将对外的批评威胁内化为自我指责，借由回避来减少Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的刺激（外部评价、失败感），短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Lacks opportunities for practice and feedback, ability and confidence are further damaged, maintaining negative beliefs
